revised_prompts: Photorealistic unedited fixed safety-inspection camera frame, 1920x1080 landscape. Camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor in a utility-room passage. Right-oblique medium-wide view with natural perspective and realistic scale. Interior has large neutral floor/wall tiles, cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, warm practical lighting, ordinary restrained contrast, documentary surveillance-camera look. A middle-aged woman with a sturdy build is clearly visible, wearing dark work trousers and a muted green jacket over brown and cream work clothing. She is repairing something from a one-knee kneel: one knee on the floor, hips and legs supporting the posture, shoulders held above the ground, body balanced naturally. Include enough surrounding context to judge body support. A column or partition partly frames one side of the image. No text, watermark, logo, labels, overlays, arrows, circles, or artificial annotations.
